definition: A model gas whose particles move randomly, have negligible volume, have no intermolecular forces between them and collide elastically.
The volume one mole of an ideal gas occupies at a stated temperature and pressure; at STP it is $\pu{22.7 dm3 mol-1}$ (data booklet).
STP: $\pu{273.15 K}$ and $\pu{100 kPa}$, the conditions for the data-booklet molar volume; not the $\pu{298.15 K}$ standard state used for thermochemical data.
The constant $R$ in the ideal gas equation $PV = nRT$, equal to $\pu{8.31 J K-1 mol-1}$ (data booklet).
